## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: unit tests written and passing (voice portion)

## Description
Failing tests for `is_active_voice(text) -> bool`. Cases: active sentences return True; passive 'Applications are reviewed by staff.' returns False; 'The form was submitted yesterday.' returns False.

## Given/When/Then
Given 'Applications are reviewed by staff.'; When is_active_voice(text) is invoked; Then it returns False because be-verb 'are' is followed by past-participle 'reviewed'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED test fails with ImportError
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k is_active_voice 2>&1 | grep -E '(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|AttributeError)' || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py: Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
